themes.label: Misalignment propagation and generalization
themes.summary: Controlled studies trace hidden-trait transfer, persistence across agent sessions, and broad unsafe generalization after narrow training; SIGMA tests alignment training across contexts.

themes.label: Monitoring reward hacking and sabotage
themes.summary: Probes, execution-grounded tasks and reward-hacking benchmarks expose gaps between pooled accuracy, monitor readouts and actual behavior; several results depend on controlled or synthetic scenarios.

themes.label: Securing and inspecting agent oversight
themes.summary: GUI control experiments distinguish retrospective detection from prevention, METR documents a patched viewer proof of concept, and Transect supports evidence-linked investigation.

themes.label: Debate and reasoning transparency
themes.summary: A formal debate protocol strengthens conditional guarantees while a human study shows rhetorical bias; looped-model experiments find task-specific rather than universal monitorability losses.

themes.label: Biological misuse evaluations
themes.summary: Two reports assess frontier-agent access to biological tools and a screening-related defensive layer. Frozen abstracts establish scope but do not provide outcome rates; full-text attempts were unavailable.

themes.label: Scaling, recursive development and pacing
themes.summary: A theoretical cyber-agent population model, conference commentary and Import AI examine collective scaling, recursive improvement and development governance; forecasts and commentary are distinct from demonstrated takeoff.

themes.label: Governance context outside the direct lane
themes.summary: Work examines public-sector participation, South African data sovereignty and Earth-science AI; a fellowship wrap-up supplies little project detail.

themes.label: Multi-agent behavior and coordination
themes.summary: Studies examine norms, disclosure, marketplace behavior, debate group effects, communication integrity and numerical signaling without establishing frontier-scale collusion.

themes.label: Interpretability and representation analysis
themes.summary: Mechanistic probes, activation steering, sparse features and symbolic reconstructions investigate model internals, including several clinical and robotic applications.

themes.label: Evaluation quality and ordinary reliability
themes.summary: Benchmarks and audits study task correctness, guardrail errors, hallucinations, data contamination, privacy, abstention and capability measurement; these do not by themselves establish catastrophic-risk findings.

themes.label: Preference learning and training behavior
themes.summary: Work covers preference aggregation, sycophancy, jailbreak-resistant tuning, ordinary reward exploits and safe-control formulations outside the featured loss-of-control results.

themes.label: Applied security, privacy and robustness
themes.summary: Studies address prompt injection, software and agent authorization, privacy leakage, unlearning, adversarial defenses and robustness in speech, robotics and other applications.
